# Positive-boundary compilation of interacting spin ground states

**Research checkpoint, 8 October 2026.** These are internally derived candidate theorems, not independently reviewed results. The analytic statements below do not depend on the new counting literature. The polynomial-time algorithmic conclusions are **conditional on Chen–Liu, arXiv:2610.06724v1, Theorem 1.6 and its finite-bit implementation**. That substantial proof has not been independently certified here. Neither its general FPRAS nor a reversible quantum implementation has been run.

The starting capital is Astra package X, especially N95–N98 and its proof `relative_kernels_and_replica_access.md`. Its positive-word argument and weighted-prefix compilation method are inherited. The changes developed here are a positive-boundary relative-vector argument, nonhomogeneous transverse-field factors, gap-free pure low-energy preparation, and selection of a **pure** ground vector, including when the ground space is degenerate. Integer-replica access is followed through to the largest Schmidt coefficient.

## 1. Model and precise outputs

On an arbitrary finite graph with n qubits, consider the rational Hamiltonian

\[
H=\frac12\sum_{e=uv}\{d_e Z_uZ_v-f_e(X_uX_v+Y_uY_v)\}
  +\sum_i h_i Z_i-\sum_i g_i X_i,
\qquad f_e\ge |d_e|,\quad g_i\ge0.
\tag{1}
\]

The longitudinal fields h_i may have either sign. Zero edges are omitted. No geometric, bounded-degree, high-temperature, physical-mixing, or area-law promise is made. Define

\[
V=\sum_e(f_e+\max(d_e,0))+2\sum_i|h_i|+\sum_i g_i.
\tag{2}
\]

Let |+> denote the n-qubit uniform product state. Let P_0 be the orthogonal projector onto the entire lowest eigenspace of H. The selected target is

\[
|\psi_0\rangle=\frac{P_0|+\rangle}{\|P_0|+\rangle\|}.
\tag{3}
\]

This is not P_0/Tr(P_0), not a ground vector chosen by the user, and not a claim about every state in a degenerate ground space.

# Relative access to rare ground-state structure

## Outcome

This run does not establish a field-breaking discovery. It develops a candidate conditional algorithmic interface that goes beyond thermal-state preparation: coherent access to a selected pure ground vector, classical relative estimation of rare ground-state events and fidelities, and relative entanglement-moment access even after rare computational-basis conditioning. It also identifies precise failures of two attempts to extend that interface to the broader EPR* family.

The model is H=.5 sum[d ZZ-f(XX+YY)]+sum hZ-sum gX on an arbitrary graph, with rational f>=|d|, g>=0 and arbitrary h. The target is psi0=P0|+>/||P0|+>||. This remains a specific PURE vector when the ground space is degenerate. It is not a request for an arbitrary ground vector.

The algorithmic premise is Chen–Liu, arXiv:2610.06724v1, Theorem1.6 and its finite-bit implementation. This is a major external mathematical dependency, not an acquired implementation in this checkpoint. Its full proof was not independently certified. The target-ground guarantees also need a supplied gap above the entire ground space, except when an applicable proved gap bound can be imported.

## The mechanism and the additional step

Astra X already supplies positive-word relative approximation and coherent/replica counting mechanisms. The present construction uses a positive boundary vector instead of an individual kernel entry: e^{tau A}1 has every coordinate at least one, for A=cI-H entrywise nonnegative. # Compact resumable research state

Date: 8 October 2026. Scope: internally derived candidate results, not independently reviewed. No field-breaking discovery established. Algorithms conditional on Chen–Liu 2610.06724v1 Thm1.6 + finite-bit argument. Do not silently replace this theorem by a free oracle, or confuse finite tests with its implementation.

## Strongest current interface

H=.5 sum[d ZZ-f(XX+YY)]+sum hZ-sum gX, on arbitrary finite graphs; rational f>=|d|, g>=0, h arbitrary. A=cI-H is entrywise nonnegative. V=sum(f+max(d,0))+2sum|h|+sum g bounds sum local generator norms.

Target psi0=P0|+>/||P0|+>|| is PURE, even with a degenerate ground space. It is not the projector mixture and not any ground vector the user chooses. P0>=0 entrywise, and <+|P0|+>>=rank(P0)/2^n>=2^-n.

For tau>0, use a positive Euler product C applied to the ALL-ONES vector. A vector-specific word cutoff k0=O(tau V+n+log1/alpha), m=O(k0^2/alpha), yields entrywise relative (1+-alpha) approximation to e^{tau A}1. Minimum finite-time entries and particle-sector acquisition are unnecessary. Every amplitude is positive. This is a refinement of inherited Astra X's positive-word mechanism, not an unrelated discovery.

Admitted local symbols: the triangle six-vertex quadratic, the nonhomogeneous transverse-field symbol tg+u+v+tg uv (tg<=1), positive longitudinal linear factors, and terminals 1+x. Complement every BRA incidence when sewing norm/replica networks; then all internal wires are linear x+y. Forgetting bra orientation incorrectly introduces a non-log-concave 1+xy wire.

Coefficient-value programs, positive individual supports, log coefficient ranges and every-execution finite bit bounds are charged. Weighted bad-prefix mass, not union bounding exponentially many prefixes, supports a randomized classical compiler with reversible count programs.
